rules: Match visits of different chips within each window. Maximize distinct pairs, then minimize total absolute separation. Use median FLC start MJD as visit time; tie break by visit IDs. Repeat independently for all metadata, all 3-band r5 colors, and all 3-band r5+r10 terms. Include 70 visits that underwent same relative-center workflow. Distinct windows and endpoint sets can reuse observations, so they are sensitivity checks rather than independent replicates.
scope: Color offsets at radius 5 are descriptive. Only pairs with both radii support an aperture term difference. Temporal matching reduces time separation but does not isolate the sensor from position, PSF, observer geometry or calibration.
